VoxelBlockyModelMesh - Voxel Tools documentation
VoxelBlockyModelMesh Inherits: VoxelBlockyModel Generates a model based on a custom mesh. Description: VoxelMesherBlocky does not require models to be cubes. Ultimately, model visuals are all meshes. This is the most versatile option to make a model. The workflow is to make these models in a 3D editor such as Blender, making sure they are confined in a box going from (0,0) to (1,1). Textures ...
